verdict.rationale: Jan keeps a public changelog with versioned release entries (e.g., v0.7.3), so some public release history exists to inspect. However, the cited entries cover only new features (browser automation MCP, pause/resume downloads) and say nothing about bug-fix or security patches or how quickly they ship. Missing for 10: evidence of critical-bug or security patch releases, a release-cadence or time-to-patch record, a security advisory or disclosure policy, and independent corroboration of patch responsiveness.
